BTC.a – Bitcoin Auto

BTC.a – Building a Smarter Digital Asset Ecosystem

BTC.a is a blockchain-based digital asset built on the BNB Smart Chain, representing the vision of Bitcoin Auto: innovation, transparency, accessibility, and the future of digital finance.

Designed with a focus on simplicity, reliability, and decentralized technology, BTC.a aims to contribute to a more accessible digital asset ecosystem.

With a fixed total supply of 2,600,000 tokens, BTC.a emphasizes transparency and a clearly defined token structure. Its smart contract supports standard ERC-20-compatible token transfers on BNB Smart Chain.
